verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments infrastructure platform. User-configurable background automations are a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. But the pack documents no feature for setting up autonomous automations or workflows. Subscriptions billing, automated reports, payout schedules and webhooks are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a user-defined automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
